About the institute

Rajarhat ke bachchon ke liye, apna coaching

2018 se Narayanpur, Battala Bazar me sthit Smart Coaching Classes ne area ke saikdon students ko board exams aur roz ki padhai me madad ki hai. Yahan har bachche ko naam se jana jata hai — bheed wala bada institute nahi, ek dhyaan dene wala centre.

  • All subjects — Maths, Science, English, SST, Bengali, Hindi & more
  • CBSE, ICSE & WB Board — teeno ka alag dhyaan
  • English, Hindi, Bengali & Urdu — chaaro medium
  • Regular tests, homework check & parent updates
  • Computer Centre — basics se advanced tak
  • Spoken English & Drawing ki alag classes

Why Smart Coaching

Parents humein kyun chunte hain

Sirf padhai nahi — system, dhyaan aur bharosa. Isi liye area ke parents saalon se yahi bhejte hain.

Chhote batches, personal dhyaan

Har batch chhota rakha jata hai, taaki teacher har bachche ki progress jaan sake — bheed me koi peeche nahi rehta.

Regular tests & report

Chapter tests aur mock exams ke marks parents ko samay par milte hain, taaki ghar par bhi progress dikhe.

Chaaro medium

English, Hindi, Bengali aur Urdu — bachcha jis medium me comfortable hai, usi me samjhaya jata hai.

Sasti, saaf-saaf fees

Area ke hisaab se rakhi gayi fees, bina kisi chhupe kharche ke. Fees ki jaankari WhatsApp par turant milti hai.

Common questions

Aksar poochhe jaane wale sawaal

Kya teeno board — CBSE, ICSE aur WB Board — ki padhai hoti hai?

Haan. Teeno boards ke syllabus ke hisaab se alag dhyaan diya jata hai, aur English, Hindi, Bengali wa Urdu — chaaro medium ke students padhte hain.

Fees kitni hai aur kaise pata chalegi?

Fees class aur course ke hisaab se hoti hai. Sahi fees jaanne ka sabse tez tareeka hai WhatsApp par message karna — hum poori fees structure ke saath reply karte hain. Koi chhupa kharcha nahi hota.

Kya beech session me admission ho sakta hai?

Haan, seat khali hone par beech session me bhi admission hota hai. Student ki pichhli padhai dekhkar use sahi batch me rakha jata hai, taaki wo jaldi class ke saath chal sake.

Computer course me kya sikhaya jata hai aur kya certificate milta hai?

Computer basics, typing, MS Office aur internet se shuru karke practical kaam tak sikhaya jata hai. Certificate courses bhi uplabdh hain — details ke liye centre par sampark karein.

Centre kahan hai aur timing kya hai?

Centre Narayanpur, Battala Bazar, Nanpuri Gali, Rajarhat, Kolkata – 700136 me hai. Subah aur shaam, dono batches chalte hain — apni class ka exact timing WhatsApp par poochh sakte hain.
